Open fire!|The super tactical droid right before his destruction|}} An '''ST-series super tactical droid''' served in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a [[commander]]. The [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] led [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]] during a [[Battle of Yerbana|battle]] on the [[planet]] [[Yerbana]] in [[19 BBY]]. The [[tactical droid]] was [[Telekinesis|Force-pulled]] out of cover and destroyed by [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] after he led the Separatist [[Separatist Droid Army|droid forces]] into a trap. ==Biography== {{Quote|Why have you ceased fire?''"
"''Jedi Knight, Anakin Skywalker, has surrendered to us, Commander.|The tactical droid and a battle droid|}} [[File:AnakinSkywalker-SWL-2025UnitCardUpdate.png|thumb|left|300px|The super tactical droid was beheaded by Anakin Skywalker (pictured as a dramatized bisection).]] The [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] served in the [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Galactic Republic]]. In [[19 BBY]], during the [[Outer Rim Sieges]], the [[tactical droid]] [[Commander|commanded]] an occupation of a [[Yerbana city|city]] on the [[planet]] [[Yerbana]]. In response, the Republic sent [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Battle of Yerbana|attack]] the Separatist [[Confederacy military|forces]] and rescue the people of the [[city]]. During the battle, the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic|force]] of [[clone trooper]]s took severe casualties while attempting to retake the city. The tactical [[droid]] remained hidden from the [[trooper]]s led by [[General]] Kenobi and [[Commander]] [[Cody|CC-2224]] "Cody," who sought to locate and destroy the droid. Skywalker intervened, pretending to surrender himself to the Separatists, and the [[battle droid]] commander notified the tactical droid of his surrender. The tactical droid came forward to question why his forces ceased fire and, quickly determining that it was a trap, berated them for being fools and ordered them to resume firing. Before he could retreat back to safety, however, Skywalker used [[the Force]] to [[Telekinesis|pull]] the tactical droid towards him and swiftly beheaded it with his [[Skywalker lightsaber|lightsaber]] as it passed him. Following the tactical droid's destruction, the Republic forces led an assault on the Separatist droids, and were ultimately successful in winning the battle. ==Characteristics== {{Quote|We can't locate the tactical droid. He's staying out of sight.|CC-2224 "Cody," to General Kenobi|}} As an ST-series super tactical droid manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata]], the droid possessed armor, leadership skills and was programmed to resist interrogation by an enemy. He also had advanced strategic programming''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' and was designed to be highly intelligent.{{Databank|super-tactical-droid|Super Tactical Droid}} This was shown by his decision to keep out of sight of the Republic forces so they could not target him and thus weaken his forces and also in how he quickly deduced that the apparent surrender of Anakin Skywalker was in fact a trap, but he did not realize that it was intended to draw him out into the open until it was too late. The droid possessed [[Color|red-orange]] [[Photoreceptor|sensors]] and fuchsia and grey plating, and stood at a height of 1.94 [[meter]]s. ==Behind the scenes== The tactical droid appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Old Friends Not Forgotten]]," released on [[April 17]], [[2020]],{{SW|url=news/clone-wars-first-look-old-friends-not-forgotten|text=''Clone Wars'' First Look: "Old Friends Not Forgotten"}} in which he was voiced by [[Donald Faison]]. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/old-friends-not-forgotten-episode-guide|text="Old Friends Not Forgotten" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SW|url=news/clone-wars-declassified-5-highlights-from-old-friends-not-forgotten|text=''Clone Wars'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Old Friends Not Forgotten"}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Anakin Skywalker (booklet)}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Superdroide táctico no identificado (Yerbana) }} [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:Separatist officers]] [[Category:Super tactical droids]]
